Versions.Failed: Module versions could not be looked up. See the console for details.
Versions.Unreached: Not every version could be looked up for: {packages}. Set a version lookup proxy in EMMA's settings to look further.

Fit.Verified: The system and every active module are verified with this version.

Drawer.IsLibrary: Yes: it provides features for other modules to use rather than its own.
Drawer.Empty: The module's manifest gives none of the details chosen to show.
Drawer.NoneChosen: No details are chosen to show. Choose them under Game Settings, in the section for EMMA.

Footer.ReadOnly: Only a GM can change which modules are active.
Footer.DisablesEmma: Saving deactivates EMMA itself, so Foundry's own Module Management window will open from then on.
Footer.NoProxy: No version lookup proxy is set, so Foundry's package listing and release notes can't be read: fewer module versions are found, and no newer Foundry version is offered. Set a proxy in EMMA's settings to look further.

Requirements.Unmet: {module} requires {missing}, which must be active too.
Requirements.LockedOne: {module} is required by {parent}, so it must stay active while it is.
Requirements.LockedMany: {module} is required by {parents}, so it must stay active while they are.

Discard.Title: Discard staged changes?
Discard.Body: The changes you staged in EMMA have not been saved. Closing the window discards them.

Disabled.Name: Disable EMMA
Disabled.Hint: Use Foundry's built-in Module Management window instead of EMMA. Takes effect immediately.

AutoRecommended.Name: Automatically activate/deactivate recommended modules
AutoRecommended.Hint: When you activate a module in EMMA, also activate the modules it recommends, and deactivate them again with it. Required modules always follow the module that requires them.

VersionProxy.Name: Version lookup proxy
VersionProxy.Label: Set proxy
VersionProxy.Hint: Browsers may not read Foundry's package listing, its release notes or most module manifests, so hypothetical mode finds fewer versions, without knowing which suit this world. Set a CORS proxy you trust to look further.
VersionProxy.Title: EMMA - version lookup proxy
VersionProxy.UrlHint: The URL of a CORS proxy you trust, with {url} where the address to fetch goes, such as https://proxy.example.com/?url={url}. Every lookup is sent through it. Leave blank to use no proxy.
VersionProxy.Invalid: The URL needs {url} where the address to fetch goes.
VersionProxy.KeyHint: Sent to the proxy in an X-API-Key header, for a proxy that asks for one. Kept in this browser only, so other users never see it: enter it again on each browser you use. Leave blank to send none.

Discard.Title: Discard proxy changes?
Discard.Body: The proxy changes you made have not been saved. Closing the window discards them.

Fields.Name: Module details
Fields.Label: Choose details
Fields.Hint: Choose which details of each module EMMA's drawers show. Only you see your choice.
Fields.Title: EMMA - module details
Fields.Legend: Details shown in each module's drawer

Discard.Title: Discard your changes?
Discard.Body: The details you chose have not been saved. Closing the window discards them.

Errors.OpenFailed: EMMA could not open, so Foundry's Module Management window has been opened instead. See the console for details.
Errors.SaveFailed: EMMA could not save which modules are active. See the console for details.
Errors.FieldsFailed: EMMA could not save which module details to show. See the console for details.
Errors.ProxyFailed: EMMA could not save the version lookup proxy. See the console for details.
